var.name: vrms_max
var.description: The sensor's velocity alarm, above its configured limit

var.name: vrms_prewarn
var.description: The sensor's early warning, below the alarm limit

var.name: acc_peak
var.description: A shock above the configured peak acceleration

cond.description: The sensor reports vibration or a shock

incident.first_step: Look at the camera recording before you go to the machine.
incident.cause: The sensor raised its velocity alarm, its early warning, or a shock alarm.

var.name: vrms_now
var.description: Vibration on the vertical axis, smoothed over ten minutes

var.name: climb
var.description: How fast that vibration climbs, per hour

var.name: in_8h
var.description: Where it lands in eight hours, if the climb holds

cond.description: Vibration climbs faster than 0.05 mm/s an hour
It reaches the alarm limit within eight hours

incident.summary: Vibration on machine 1 climbs towards its limit
incident.first_step: Plan a bearing inspection at the next stop. The machine can still run.
incident.cause: ="Vibration reads " & vrms_now & " mm/s and climbs " & climb & " mm/s an hour."

var.name: temp
var.description: Sensor temperature, averaged over five minutes

var.name: rise
var.description: How fast that temperature rises, per hour

cond.description: Still rising, faster than 2 C an hour

incident.summary: Machine 1 runs hot and keeps heating
incident.first_step: Stop the machine if the temperature passes 85 C.
incident.cause: ="The sensor reads " & temp & " C and rises " & rise & " C an hour."

cond.description: No new reading from the sensor for five minutes

incident.summary: No readings from the sensor on machine 1
incident.first_step: Check the IO-Link cable and the port LED on the master.
incident.cause: The master polls the port, but the sensor sends no new value.
